items.name: sfx_fridge_open
items.text: a household refrigerator door pulled open: one soft rubber seal unsticking pop, then a low steady electric compressor hum, close, quiet room

items.name: sfx_light_click
items.text: one small plastic light switch click inside a refrigerator, then a low electric hum that stops abruptly into silence

items.name: sfx_rewind_ice
items.text: fast reversed sound of ice cracking and wind, a rising backwards whoosh with tiny crackles, about two seconds, ends abruptly

items.name: sfx_ice_chisel
items.text: two sharp metal chisel strikes on thick river ice, bright crisp chips flying, cold outdoor night, short gap between strikes

items.name: sfx_ice_slide
items.text: a heavy block of ice sliding across ice then dropping into a dark pit with one dull thud

items.name: sfx_ice_bronze
items.text: a block of ice knocked down into a bronze vessel: one hollow metallic clunk with a short bronze ring

items.name: sfx_ladle_pour
items.text: a bronze ladle pouring a little cold wine into a small cup, short liquid pour, then a faint tiny frost crackle

items.name: sfx_silver_ting
items.text: one single clear light ting of a silver bowl struck softly, bright and pure, short ring

items.name: sfx_chisel_stone
items.text: two hard chisel strikes on frozen ice that sound like chiselling stone, ringing hard clacks at night, slight echo

items.name: sfx_drips
items.text: slow single water drips falling into a small puddle in a cool stone cellar, one drop every half second, quiet

items.name: sfx_brass_bowls
items.text: two small brass bowls clinked together twice in one hand, a bright ringing clang clang, street vendor call signal

items.name: sfx_ice_glass
items.text: three ice cubes dropped into an empty glass tumbler: crisp clinks and a short rattle

items.name: sfx_frost_bloom
items.text: a soft crystalline shimmer of frost forming on glass, delicate icy tinkling sparkle swelling then fading

items.name: sfx_mist_breath
items.text: a soft cool airy whoosh of cold mist breathing out and spreading across a stone floor, gentle
